item.title: Capture 0.4
item.description:
Checks is now called Capture. It updates in place, and your notes stay.
Long recordings split into short clips, one for each thing you talk about. One bar for recordings and screenshots, with the keys 1 to 6. Nothing is asked after Keep. One field that listens or takes typing. Notes are grouped by model, and a click changes a note's model. The address of the page a note was made on is no longer sent to Checks. Rating a note is now on Checks. Clips that were too large to send are made smaller, and go.

item.title: Checks 0.3
item.description: Record a section of the screen or all of it. Take a whole window. Write about text you have selected. Say which model you are testing once. Mark a note Liked, Missed or Surprised. Checks now updates itself.
